hardware: Apple M1 Pro, 16 GiB unified memory, macOS 26.3 arm64, CPU only (no GPU used by v14)
external_resources: dataset-v1 public archive and evaluator revision 65b98e480f2a10b82f974f4feb519ee4e012d66c; supplied local drawings are required at inference
v14 uses no pretrained or external weights; both models were trained on the public training split only (fit split plus real development documents). No external training dataset was added.
Inference uses local model files and original drawing assets and does not fetch annotations or weights
peak_memory_mb uses decimal MB of measured peak memory footprint; the inference run had 0 swaps. Runtime covers the whole Python process; scoring and packaging are excluded.
time_spent_hours was last captured for v2 and must be recomputed at publication.

Public validation was scored for v1-v3 and v6-v14, and earlier errors informed research directions, so the v14 score is validation-informed; no v14 setting was selected on public validation. Query cleaner g2, threshold 0.25 and the color gate are copied from v7; the stage-2 size (600 rounds, 63 leaves) was chosen by document-grouped cross-validation on training documents with a pre-registered rule, and v14 was declared primary before training (PROGRESS.md checkpoint 22). Freeze: artifacts/frozen-pipeline-v14.json.
v2 and v7 are preserved as fallbacks; v14 has the highest IoU and precision and the lowest FPR, with recall 0.974 below the 0.98 target; the 95% IoU, 90% precision and 5% FPR targets remain unmet.
